avis.titre: Shocked at how much I love this!
avis.texte: I haven't tried a chemical sunscreen on my face in years unless it was from a Japanese or Korean brand. For whatever reason, American drugstore chemical sunscreens would always make my eyes burn, even when I didn't get it anywhere close to them. But I've been dying to try the Vacation line, and with the sale, I figured I'd just use it on my body if it was too irritating for my face. However, this is maybe the best face sunscreen I've used in years. It has a light hint of the Vacation sunscreen smell, just enough to be pleasant and cover up the chemical sunscreen smell that I hate. It sank in immediately and felt like almost nothing on my face. Absolute perfection! No stinging eyes or irritated skin. My only wish is that they offered a higher SPF (either 50 like the body sunscreen or even higher). Otherwise I love it and I'm dedicated to it.
I recently purchased the face lotion after a great experience with the SPF body lotion. Not only is the product super effective but the smell is AMAZING!
I wear sunscreen everyday and wanted something for summer, this went on smoothly with no white cast. My sensitive skin didn't show any irritation. And it smells great, but not overpowering.
Great smell, great texture, great ingredients. I will be buying this again.

avis.titre: Protect your face and smell good!
avis.texte: Great sun protection for your face! This goes on smooth with very little white cast after it has soaked in. The smell is obviously amazing.

I like the smell and the texture. But it's so hard finding a face sunscreen that doesn't burn my eyes. I've worn it 3 times and did my best to avoid my eye area and I still suffered each time. Eucerin is the only eye safe one I have found.

This face lotion with SPF is my first product from Vacation, and I must say… I am a fan! I knew it was a chemical sunscreen, so I was surprised when it came out of the bottle white. I relaxed again once I rubbed it in, as it quickly became sheer. The lotion provides great coverage without a greasy finish. I also found it layered well under my Elf primer & Haus Labs foundation, and it didn't cause pilling. The lotion's scent is pleasant, and not overpowering. I am also happy with the 3 oz size of the product. Other facial sunscreens provide less product, and I feel that causes me to be sheepish with my application. Very happy with this Vacation SPF Facial Lotion!

avis.titre: Makes me want to wear SPF!
avis.texte: This is one of those SPFs that actually makes you want to wear sunscreen every day The texture is super lightweight and feels more like a moisturizer than a traditional sunscreen It blends in effortlessly with zero white cast and leaves a really pretty natural glow on the skin According to product details it's designed to feel invisible on all skin tones while still delivering solid SPF 45 protection with added hydration and antioxidants What I love most is how wearable it is under makeup It doesn't pill, doesn't feel greasy, and gives that smooth hydrated base that makes your skin look healthy on its own Over time I noticed my skin stayed more balanced and never dried out throughout the day It feels lightweight, hydrating, and gives a natural radiant finish that layers beautifully with makeup, but if you're sensitive to scent you might notice the subtle signature fragrance. An easy everyday SPF that looks good, feels good, and actually makes you consistent with wearing sunscreen which is the biggest win

avis.titre: Goes on so easy and smells heavenly
avis.texte: Lovely for your face or picky child. We used on….vacation, and no burns in our family.

It's rare to find an SPF that actually delivers on the "invisible" promise, but this one is a total game-changer. I've always avoided sunscreens because of that dreaded heavy, chalky white cast, yet this formula disappears instantly. It feels weightless, like I'm wearing nothing at all.However, it isn't quite perfect. There is a strange, lingering scent that I find pretty off-putting. If you can move past the odd smell, the efficiency and finish are unbeatable. It's a top-tier choice for protection without the typical greasy mess. Received this product for my honest opinion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I typically reach for mineral sunscreens, but I was really impressed with this face lotion! Usually sunscreen lotions are heavy and leave a white cast on my skin. I did not have this issue at all. This sunscreen lotion was easy to blend into my skin, and did not leave any white cast. It had a pleasant smell, and reminded me of summertime during my childhood. It was also easy to blend into my skin, and did not feel like it was sitting on top of my skin. I have only tested this sunscreen with light make up on top, but I did not notice any creasing or cakey feeling after applying blush and bronzer over top. Overall I was surprised with how much I liked this sunscreen lotion! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I absolutely love Vacation products- so when I saw they had a new *face specific* sunscreen to try out, I was intrigued! My first impression was the texture/thickness was perfect for a facial sunscreen. It wasn't too thick, nor too thin. It absorbed rather quickly and didn't leave me feeling greasy or heavy. Since I have combination skin, this is frequently a concern of mine. But it turned out to be perfect! It sat well throughout the day as well and did not 'melt' my makeup off, which I appreciated. It did its job and prevented me from getting burned, while also keeping my skin looking & feeling amazing. I did not break out and did not notice any irritation- this is definitely going into my daily routine! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

As a gal with the winter pallor of a sickly Victorian orphan, I'm perpetually working to protect my skin.Vacation Inc has always been great for me, and the Classic Face Lotion in SPF 45 is no exception. I could write paragraphs on their amazing packaging and marketing, but that seems unnecessary at this point.The Classic Face Lotion has that amazing classic Vacation scent, which propels me back to my childhood and much less stressful times. The lotion goes on smoothly with the slightest sheen, while I can feel that I'm wearing a sunscreen, it isn't overly heavy or greasy. As previously mentioned, I'm pale, but I definitely don't get any white cast. It seems to go on smoothly under makeup as well.To be fair, it's still not pool weather in the PNW, so I haven't tried it poolside or anything but it seems like a winner, as I assumed it would and I love that it's SPF 45! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I really enjoy this product and can't wait to utilize it everyday in the summer! This sunscreen doesn't leave a white cast which is an issue that I always run into when it comes to facial sunscreen. It also blends in really well and quickly absorbs into the face, not leaving any kind of residue or stickiness behind. I personally love the scent of this product because it reminds me of summer, the beach, and just overall smells "tropical". Would definitely suggest everyone try this out if you are looking for a reliable sunscreen! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is a wonderful year around sunscreen for your face. I enjoy the vacation brand and all their products. This one is new to me as I have never tried their face sunscreens before. It is spf 45 and water resistant to 80 minutes. I think a big difference from other high end sunscreens is vacation gives you 3oz unlike the usual 1-2oz. You get a lot of Product for your money and it can easily last you all season. The bottle is plastic so it will travel well with you. The product does have some of the typical sunscreen scent but it does go away when it dries down. Every time I used it, it has kept my face protected from any potential burns. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Classic face lotion spf 45 by Vacation
avis.texte: Vacation Classic Face lotion spf 45 smells so good. It's that OG (but good) suntan lotion scent from back in the day. I'm really pale so I have to either be very careful and use a good spf. This one is so lightweight you can't even tell you're wearing anything plus zero white cast! You must reapply after being in water every 80 minutes but that's the same with any spf so you can't get away from reapplication if you want to stay protected. This works great as a primer under makeup. It makes my skin look plump and hydrated but it's not oily or greasy. It's Paraben free and the squeeze bottle it comes in makes it so easy to apply and reapply whenever you need to. It also rubs in very easily and quickly. received as a part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Honestly this has been my first time trying this product, this brand, and (i know this one will be a crazy one…), but a sunscreen into my daily makeup and skincare routine… and i must say i cant believe i havent done this sooner! Especially this product and im sooo glad this one is the first one i tried! I completely fell in love with jt with how smooth it is, how clear and lightweight it is/feels, can be used day and night, i loved everything about it and im glad i received this as a part of an educational promotion! ️ if youre debating on trying this out, DO IT! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Does exactly what I need it to!
avis.texte: I've been using the Vacation Classic Face Lotion SPF 45 two weeks now, and it's quickly become part of my daily routine. The first thing I noticed is how lightweight it feels!! It's almost like a moisturizer rather than a traditional sunscreen because it blends in really easily and doesn't leave a white cast, which is a huge plus, especially for everyday wear. I also appreciate that it doesn't feel greasy or heavy on my skin. My skin still feels hydrated throughout the day, which I think is due to the added skincare ingredients like hydrators and antioxidants. The scent is subtle but noticeable. I actually love the scent, I thought it had sort of a banana smell. That might not be it but it feels fresh and slightly nostalgic. I personally like it, but if you're sensitive to fragrance, it's something to keep in mind. Overall, this sunscreen does exactly what I need it to do & I think It's a solid option if you're looking for a face sunscreen that doesn't "feel" like sunscreen. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Vacation has been my new go to products. I always love how the packaging comes it's like you're going to the beach or to a vacation.This face lotion is small and easy to travel with. I didn't realize that there was foil when I first started squeezing it out. Once I took the foil off alot of the product came out but it was the right amount. I used it all over my face and I could feel the difference immediately after using it.My skin felt alot softer and I know that it was also protected from the high amount of spf 45. I cannot wait to travel with this product when I travel. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is an invisible sunscreen that is super lightweight I do not even feel like I have anything on. My face looked a little glowy after use. It is not a runny sunscreen and was really easy to apply. The scent is like a fruity coconut drink on the beach. This makes putting sunscreen on painless and fun. The packaging is good and the opening is just the perfect size to dispense the product. My only complaint is with the smell. There is a slight hint of paint smell that I am not a fan of in this product. Other than that I love this sunscreen and would purchase. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Long-lasting, and smells like summer vacay!
avis.texte: I have combination, fair/light skin that requires a daily sunscreen. This is a perfect face sunscreen by Vacation to layer under makeup with a good 45 SPF. There's no white cast, and it melts right into my skin while keeping it hydrated. It's never sticky, and has many fantastic ingredients like Argan Oil, Vitamin E, Aloe Vera, Niacinamide, and Shea Butter that are so good for your skin. I love the squeeze tube because it's easy to apply without having too much product come out all at once. The scent is perfect. It reminds me of summer vacation and coconuts. I highly recommend this sunscreen! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Nostalgia, SPF, & Glow Up in a Bottle
avis.texte: Living at the beach means I basically live in sunscreen and Vacation Inc. Classic Face Lotion SPF 45 has been on repeat. It gives the prettiest dewy glow like my skin but better which I love. Zero white cast which is non negotiable. The scent is everything it literally smells like an 80s luxury resort and instantly triggers nostalgia for me like a core memory in a bottle. It is lightweight layers perfectly under makeup and does not clog my pores or break me out even in humidity. This one just does it all and actually makes me excited to wear their SPF every single day. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been loving this new face SPF from Vacation!! It's so lightweight and doesn't feel heavy or greasy at all. The formula is white however it turns invisible and no white cast which I appreciate! It doesn't have a fringe of smell either which is nice. It blends so seamlessly and with ease and not thick like most other formulas. I love that it has clean ingredients and the process point is incredible. I've been absolutely loving and hasn't caused any breakouts or skin irritation. I love a good spf and this one did not disappoint! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I honestly didn't expect much when I first tried this, but it surprised me in a good way. I've been using it almost every day before going out, and it feels really nice on the skin. Not heavy, not sticky, and it doesn't leave that weird white layer like some sunscreens do.It absorbs pretty fast, so I don't have to wait forever before putting on makeup. My skin also doesn't feel oily after, which I really care about.The smell is light and pleasant, nothing overpowering. I've worn it on warmer days and it still felt comfortable.Overall, it's just simple and easy to use, and that's what I like about it.Product was received as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am familiar with the Vacation Inc. brand and have always had a good experience so I was excited to try their Classic Face Lotion SPF 45. I used it a few times & am a little stumped! The first time I used it, I liked it. It is thicker than a typical face lotion and has the typical beachy sunscreen smell. You don't have to use too much as it does apply pretty white, but as long as you rub it in, it dissolves. It felt dewy on my skin and for someone with dry skin- that was r her eat!However the last time I used it, my face skin went crazy! After a little bit of time passed, I had red spots all over and my skin felt very tight and dry. I'm not sure if this product caused it or not, but it was the last product I used so I'm assuming it was. Nothing would calm my skin down either & everything I tried after stung. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Vacation products are the best products that money can buy. I was elated to try the Face SPF 45 face lotion. This product was so great because I live in Texas and I love how protected my skin was from the sun. This product is easy to glide on the skin and left my skin feeling great, sunburn protected, and smelled so good. I now carry this in my purse and apply every day. My son is ultra sensitive to the heat in UV rays. Vacation products are some of my favorite and this will now continue to be in my skin care routine. I would highly recommend. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I tried Vacation Inc. Classic Face Lotion SPF 45, and I absolutely love it!! I have to admit, my secret favorite aspect of this product is the smell! It brings me back to childhood with its delicious, banana pudding scent, which is lovely since this product is applied near the nose. But what I came to this product for is the sun protection. I am a sunscreen apostle. I have fair skin that I didn't take proper care of in my youth, but now, SPF is a must every single morning. This delivers a powerful 45 SPF. So, best of all worlds, fun-smelling, powerful skin protection. This product was received as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I usually love every product from Vacation Inc. and the Classic Face Lotion SPF 45 is no different! The formula is a really nice creamy, lotion and is not sticky at all. It blends in really nicely & does not make my face look overly oily or anything like that. When trying this out, I was outside and very sweaty, I never noticed it burning my eyes or anything like that which I have had issues with using other facial sunscreens. The packaging is a super cute 80s vibe & I don't know why but I really love their over all product packaging! Love this product and will be buying more this summer! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using Vacation Inc. SPF face sunscreen and honestly really like it. It goes on super light, doesn't leave that annoying white cast, and feels good on my skin all day. It doesn't get greasy or clog my pores, which is a big plus. I can wear it alone or under makeup without any issues. Definitely a solid everyday sunscreen I'd keep buying. This will definitely last me a few months. Theres no scent to it other than the regular suncreen scent, which i dont mind. The size is also great for travel. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have been using the Vacation Premium Sunscreen Face Lotion SPF 45 daily and I really enjoy how it feels on my skin. It is very lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any white cast or greasy finish. I love wearing it under my makeup because it layers smoothly and doesn't cause any pilling. The SPF 45 gives me strong protection, and the fact that it is water resistant makes it perfect for long days out. It also keeps my skin feeling soft and hydrated thanks to ingredients like niacinamide and aloe. Since it is dermatologist tested, I feel safe and confident using it every day. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

My go to sunblock for a day at the beach or the grocery store. It's perfect for an everyday sunblock under makeup. It provides a smooth canvas for even makeup application. It's ultra light weight, has no white cast, and has a sheer finish. It's water resistant so I don't worry about sweating it off in the Florida heat. I love that it has antioxidants, coconut, banana, and skin care grade hydrators. And of course it has the classic Vacation Signature scent. It's a whole vibe in a bottle. And I adore the entire retro inspired aesthetic all Vacation products embody. I would recommend this to anyone who wants to protect their skin from the sun and have a little fun. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Great Sunscreen for Vacation- Pun Intended
avis.texte: This is a wonderful sunscreen, from scent, to texture, to wear and absorption. I usually use Korean sunscreens, as I find American sunscreens lackluster; minerals are too thick and give me a white cast and chemicals irritate my eyes. This sunscreen is a chemical sunscreen and despite the addition of Avobenzone that usually burns my eyes, this one does not (WIN!). The smell is fantastic, it does have a bit of a "sunscreeny" smell, but it genuinely reminds me of vacation in the best way possible. It absorbs so easily into my skin and my moisturizer and makeup lay beautifully with it as well. This is going to be my go-to face sunscreen for summer for sure! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This sunscreen has a very smooth texture that is easy to apply and quick to absorb into my skin. The typical sunscreen scent isn't as strong as others, and it also has pleasant notes of coconut and banana that feel really summery. When I wear this, my skin doesn't look greasy or have a white cast. I did notice when I laid out on a hot day, the sunscreen burned my eyes a bit. Because of that, and the very beachy smell, I won't be wearing this as my everyday sunscreen, but I will use it on pool/beach days. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Vacation is my absolute favorite sunscreen brand. The scent instantly transports me to summer—it smells amazing and truly enhances the experience. Most importantly, it works; I've never gotten a burn while using it. That said, unfortunately my sensitive skin didn't love this facial formula and it did cause some breakouts. I've found the Vacation Crystal Gel works much better for me personally. If you don't have very sensitive skin like mine, you'll likely love this sunscreen and the summery feel it gives. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This Classic Face Lotion by Vacation is a staple not only for my summer bag but for my everyday wear. The clean formula soaks into the skin leaving behind no white cast at all. It's got some amazing skin care ingredients like hyaluronic acid, vitamin e and niacinamide. While it does help hydrate my skin it doesn't leave it feeling oily or greasy throughout the day. It really dos have a "barely there" feel to it and it doesn't feel heavy like other sunscreens do. Also my skin doesn't break out at all while using this. The wonderful signature vacation scent is just an added bonus. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I admit it, I only wear sunscreen because I HAVE to... and living in Arizona makes it a double HAVE to. Another thing, I'm not going to trade off my hard earned finished makeup look if it's not going to last on top of facial sunscreen. In the past, I've taken the time to meticulously apply the sunscreen, then my makeup, only to watch it all "pill" up as I'm applying my foundation. I think I even screamed on one occasion. In the morning when I'm in a rush getting ready for work, the last thing I have time to do, or want to do, is wash my face and start my makeup all over again. But all is good now. I honestly think the people at Vacation had this in mind when they developed their "FACE" SPF45 face lotion. It's lightweight, blends easily and leaves a smooth canvas, almost welcoming my foundation and concealer. I also feel good about the level of SPF. Did I mention that it smells good too? It smells good too. Thank you Vacation. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This Face lotion is the ultimate sunscreen protector! I love Vacation products so much! High quality, and wonderful notes . This face lotion reminded of tropical, sun and springtime. Smells of banana and hint of pineapple. The texture is very creamy and a small amount goes a long away and coverage is good. I really like the high SPF content. It is also water resistant which is a plus. When applied it doesn't feel too greasy or too thick. It is a white color, but when rubbed in to the skin it blends in well and invisible. I will definitely continue to use this. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Easy Everyday SPF That Feels Lightweight
avis.texte: I've been using this SPF and I like it a lot. I received this product for an honest review, and it turned out to be really nice for everyday use. It feels light on the skin and spreads easily without feeling heavy. It doesn't leave any white cast and it gives a nice healthy glow without making my skin oily. I can wear it daily and also when I put the makeup on. It has a subtle tropical scent a bit coconuty that feels nice, but if you don't like fragrance, you might notice it. It didn't irritate my skin and feels comfortable all day. Overall, it's a simple and good everyday sunscreen that is easy to use. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

As a flight attendant, i'm constantly exposed to the sun through aircraft windows, so having a reliable daily SPF is really important to me. I've tried a lot of face sunscreens and Vacation classic face lotion with SPF 45 is one of the very best! The texture is lightweight and silky smooth almost like a primer, which makes it really easy to wear daily and especially under makeup. It blends in effortlessly without leaving a white cast. It isn't sticky or greasy-feeling at all! I also loved that it doesn't have the typical sunscreen smell. it had a subtle scent that fades quickly and didn't irritate my skin at all. As expected, this SPF lotion does need to be reapplied, especially when you're sweating under the hot sun. Overall, this is one of the few sunscreens I actually look forward to using every day. I received this product complimentary in return for my honest review. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Sun protection I'm willing to use!
avis.texte: I have normal skin that is recovering from dryness due to a combination of my Tretinoin and the winter. I do know the importance of wearing sunscreen every day, especially with retinoid use, but I still dread it due to the unpleasant heavy texture and white cast I often experience with sunscreens. With that, I was excited to try the VACATION INC Classic Face Lotion SPF 45, as I've tried their body sunscreens before with great results and also fun. This sunscreen is a lightweight white cream with a light tropical scent (if you know the classic Vacation scent, it is this scent, but quite light and unobtrusive). I applied enough to cover my face and neck in the mornings. This appeared to provide me enough protection, as I only step outside during the morning and afternoon for about 5 minutes each way, and the window near my desk doesn't get enough sunlight. This product is super lightweight, as in I could barely feel it on my skin. I tested reapplying on two days, and it was easy to reapply and the product didn't start moving towards my eyes and burning it. Given the SPF 45, I was positively shocked. In addition, it did not leave a white cast on my face. As a person with a medium skin tone, it was nice to not look like a ghost in my effort to be responsible with skincare. Lastly, the scent is so pleasant and reminds me of a beach. It makes getting up in the morning to trudge to work just a tiny bit more bearable. Overall, I truly enjoyed using the VACATION INC Classic Face Lotio

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Honestly I really like Vacation products, they focus on spf and their approach to marketing and product packaging has helped reach many. Theyre popularity has made sun protection cool and important! You can always count on the packing to be cute and the scent to smell like a vacation. This one smells just like that! It blends in without leaving a white cast. The only con to this spf is that its still on the thicker side and does feel like you're youre usually SPF. It does take a few minutes to absorb but nothing a hand fan can't do. Personally I don't like the consistency of it but itsk not all that bad, its got spf 45 and smells like vacay! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have been using the Classic Vacation Inc sunscreen for a few years and love it. I was so happy to see that they came out with a SPF 45 made specifically for the face. The sunscreen has the same captivating smell of the original (coconut banana) in a lightweight formula. After applying it did not leave a white cast and it was lightweight enough to wear under my makeup. I appreciate that it is made with amazing skin care ingredients like hyaluronic acid and niacinamide. It left my skin feeling as hydrated as some of my very expensive face products. We haven't had great weather so I can't attest to how it will hold up outside just yet, if it anything like Vacation Inc's other products this will become my go to for my pool bag all summer long. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Let's just say I'm a skincare junkie and I use spf daily. I love this face SPF 45 by vacation. It has a subtle coconut scent that gives beach vibes. This can be used on your travels or in your daily routine. I have used it for over a week after my serum and light moisturizer. If your skin is on the combo to oily side, you can skip the moisturizer. This formulation is very hydrating and works well under makeup. There is no white cast. I love that vacation has incorporated skincare ingredients such as hyaluronic acid and niacinamide. My skin feels very soft after applying and I found this to be very lightweight. I love the nostalgic design of the tube. It reminds me of the 80s. I plan to use this tube to the last drop and would recommend this for any skin tone or skin type. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

there isnt a product from Vacation that I haven't liked, and this Classic Face Lotion SPF 45 is no different. the scent reminds you of childhood and going to the beach. most SPFs don't feel this lightweight or rub in so easily. I included a photo of what it looks like on my skin straight from the bottle, and in front, I rubbed it into the skin. once rubbed in, there is no white cast, but there is a nice glow left behind. It works well under makeup too, which makes this a great everyday option, not just for beach days. as a pale girly who burns very easily, this is my new go-to daily SPF, especially for the summer. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Oh wow!! This stuff is fantastic. The SPF 40 is a big benefit to me being in an area that has a very high UV index a good portion of the year. It has the classic Vacation signature scent that I'm obsessed with! There really was no white cast at all and it blended into my skin well. I used this as the very last step in my cleansing routine. I did wear this a few times in the water (a pool), and I found the claim of 80 minute protection be pretty accurate. This is a very lightweight facial sunscreen. It is not greasy, or heavy. I did not experience any reaction with this and it paired with the rest of my regimen fine. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: No white cast, soft glow, and lightweight
avis.texte: Vacation Inc's Classic Face Lotion SPF 45 gives your skin a nice glow without appearing greasy. The consistency reminds me of body lotion, but it feels a lot lighter on the skin. When applying, it didn't take long to blend in, and there was absolutely no white cast. The sunscreen didn't make my skin feel oily; instead, my skin felt soft and smooth. It has a light coconut scent that smells so good. I love that it is water resistant, so it's perfect for swimming. My only issue is that it is not safe around the eyes, which is very common in sunscreens. I usually prefer sunscreens that are safe around the eyes, but I'm okay with ones that aren't. Overall, I like this SPF 45 face lotion by Vacation Inc for the consistency, no white cast, and soft glow that it gives my skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Beachy, Lightweight SPF That Feels Good on Skin
avis.texte: This squeeze bottle is a matte pale yellow with a brighter yellow lid, which fits the sunny weather vibe perfectly. The navy writing over it reminds me of the sky, which visually is a nice touch. The cap flips open easily and dispenses the perfect amount without making a mess.The scent is to die for! It's an instant mood boost. It gives that classic beachy, slightly sweet scent similar to Jergens suntan oil (the brown bottle). It immediately reminds me of sunny weather and good times, with no chemical smell at all.It also plays really well with my skincare routine and makeup. It dries down transparent, doesn't feel heavy on my skin, and I haven't had any breakouts while using it. I also appreciate that it contains niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, especially since I tend to prefer more skincare forward formulas.Truthfully, I was initially worried SPF 45 wouldn't be enough for my pale skin, but I haven't had any issues so far. A new favorite! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I always wear sunscreen year-round, since my dermatologist will definitely be able to tell if I'm lying. LOL! I really liked this one. It does have a slight scent, but I found it pleasant and not long-lasting or overpowering. A little went a long way, and it layered nicely underneath my jelly primer and makeup without pilling. There was no white cast, and the texture was pretty lightweight, not thick or tacky. I also think the bottle is a good value, since you don't need to use a lot to cover your face, and it will last a long time. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Finally a face sunscreen from Vacation!
avis.texte: I really love this Face lotion that Vacation has launched. avis.titre: Lightweight SPF That Feels Like a Vacation
avis.texte: I've been really impressed with the Vacation Inc Classic Face Lotion SPF 45. It's lightweight, smooth, and blends into my skin effortlessly without leaving a white cast or greasy feeling. I love how comfortable it feels on my face—almost like a daily moisturizer rather than a sunscreen. It layers beautifully under makeup and doesn't pill, which is a huge plus for my morning routine. My skin feels hydrated and protected throughout the day, even when I'm spending time outdoors. I appreciate the subtle, fresh scent that gives it a fun, summery vibe without being overpowering. Overall, this sunscreen makes it easy to remember to protect my skin every day. avis.titre: Spf I actually want to wear
avis.texte: Who knew there was sunscreen out here I would actually enjoy? This sunscreen helped shield my skin from UVA radiation and offered respectable coverage to my skin. avis.titre: Transported to summer with this sunscreen
avis.texte: Summer is coming! It was a long Michigan winter, and this sunscreen transported me to a sunny day by the pool. The fragrance is nostalgic and hip. Living in Texas, sunscreen is a non-negotiable for me year-round, and Vacation Inc.'s Classic Face Lotion SPF 45 is one of my favorite face sunscreens I have tried. It sits well under light makeup too. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Daily sunscreen that feels light and comfortable
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by the Vacation Classic Face Lotion SPF 45. I have fair combination skin and I live in a very sunny state, so daily sun protection is an essential step in my routine. I try to protect my skin from photoaging and hyperpigmentation, which means I apply sunscreen every morning before makeup whenever I leave the house. This sunscreen fits easily into that routine. The packaging is compact and practical, and the lotion comes out easily from the tube. It's small enough to keep in a purse or take with you while traveling, which makes it convenient for reapplication during the day. The texture is rich but not heavy. It spreads quickly and evenly across the skin and absorbs within a short time. I also enjoyed the gentle, pleasant scent, which makes the application feel more enjoyable compared to many traditional sunscreens.After applying, the lotion leaves my skin feeling hydrated with a soft, natural glow. It doesn't feel greasy and sits well under light makeup. When I apply a translucent powder on top, the sunscreen remains invisible and comfortable throughout the day. For me, this sunscreen works well as a daily protective step because it combines broad spectrum SPF 45 protection with a texture that feels lightweight and easy to wear. It's a product that can be used consistently without disrupting the rest of a skincare or makeup routine. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Vacation Inc.'s Classic Face Lotion SPF 45 is one of those sunscreens that just slips into your routine without any fuss. It feels lightweight going on—more like a regular moisturizer than a sunscreen—and it doesn't leave that heavy, greasy layer you end up regretting later. The finish is natural, not shiny, and it plays nicely under makeup. There's a subtle "Vacation" scent, but it's soft enough that it doesn't linger or compete with anything else you're wearing. Overall, it's an easy, everyday SPF that does its job. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Vacation brand delivers high quality SPF

I try to wear SPF daily to help protect my skin. My face is very freckled from skin damage from years of tanning (ugh I know, I should have listened to my mother) so now I try my best protect my skin from harmful UV rays. I love that the face lotion is water resistant and dermatologist tested. Having water resistant sunscreen is important for me because I am active outdoors and sweat but also when I go swimming I know I have that extra coverage. Vacation brand sunscreen has proven again that they deliver when it comes to quality sunscreen. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.
